title: A wrong one-time code offered at the registry's row is a counted guess
assertion: A wrong code offered to `hardware_key_record` is counted and the count is committed (the function answers no row; a raise would roll the count back); the web then refuses, the refusal is on record once and the key is removed at the provider
noFileReason: Synthetic personas and keys the tests make in memory (a software authenticator, a provider twin); no file.
